label: EWSR1::CREB3L1

sections.text: EWSR1 encodes an RNA-binding protein whose amino-terminal region can activate transcription.
CREB3L1 encodes an endoplasmic-reticulum-associated bZIP transcription factor activated by proteolysis.

The fusion joins the amino-terminal FET-family activation region to CREB3L DNA-binding sequences and creates an aberrant bZIP transcription factor. EWSR1::CREB3L1 is characteristic of pure sclerosing epithelioid fibrosarcoma.
